facts.name: Bill row count and total
facts.described_as: Count, or total the quantity or amount of, the bill of quantities rows whose description contains every given term (optionally only inside a section). Use this for 'how many items ...' and 'what is the total quantity / amount of ...' over a bill: it reads every row of the bill and lists the rows it used with reference and page. Report its count, sum and rows as given; do not add figures yourself.

inputs.name: terms
inputs.label: description words
inputs.described_as: Words every matching row's description contains.

inputs.name: section
inputs.label: section words
inputs.described_as: Words of the bill section (heading path) to stay inside. Optional.

inputs.name: document_id
inputs.label: document id
inputs.described_as: The bill document (source PDF or its derived sheet). Optional: default every derived bill.
